datasource_item.source_question_text:
A Chinook salmon can jump out of water with a speed v0 and an angle 𝜃 above the horizontal. What is the speed of the fish when it is at the maximum height?
A. 𝑣0. [incorrect]
B. 𝑣0 cos𝜃. [correct]
C. 𝑣0 sin𝜃. [incorrect]
D. 0. [incorrect]
datasource_item.generated_question_text:
A tennis ball is launched with initial speed v0 at an angle θ above the horizontal (ignore air resistance). What is the ball’s speed at the top of its trajectory?
A. v0 sin θ [incorrect] Explanation: This is incorrect because v0 sin θ is the initial vertical component, which becomes zero at the top.
B. v0 cos θ [correct] Explanation: This is correct because the vertical velocity is zero at maximum height while the horizontal component remains v0 cos θ.
C. v0 [incorrect] Explanation: This is incorrect because the vertical component decreases to zero, so the speed is less than v0 unless θ = 0.
D. 0 [incorrect] Explanation: This is incorrect because only the vertical component is zero at the top; the horizontal component generally remains nonzero.
